_comment: Expected node-to-authority mapping inventory for Explorer V5.11.
_purpose: Exact-snapshot comparison: the proof checks the candidate's NODE_TO_AUTHORITY mapping against this inventory. Missing, extra, or mismatched entries are hard failures. This inventory lives in the same candidate revision as timeline.js and detects one-sided mapping deletion. No affirmative independent, frozen, or drift-resistant authority claim is made. The explicit limitation (coordinated deletion from both files is not detected) is preserved.
